genotypes: Measured aligned QC genotypes only; imputed scans deferred
meta_analysis: GEMMA fixed-effect inverse-variance beta/SE; GMMAT sum of aligned independent score and information
marker_family: Intersection of aligned candidate loci with identical CanFam4 coordinate and REF/ALT; require cohort MAF >= 0.025 in each breed for inference
correction: Within each analysis: alpha/common aligned candidate count before cohort filtering; no across-method correction
independence: Disjoint dog IDs required; no known cross-breed family links; unresolved cross-breed dependence remains a limitation
pooled_relationship: Shared aligned background from union of breed LD-pruned sets; center and scale separately within each broader breed, then form one LOCO cross-product matrix
pooled_missing: Within-breed and scheme mean ALT dosage; same numeric inputs for both methods
pooled_role: Exploratory sensitivity only; inclusion in publication undecided
interpretation: No automatic discovery claims; meta-analysis inherits small-case and fit limitations; two-breed heterogeneity is weakly estimated; no automatic genomic-control rescaling
